purpose: Test whether a fresh ChatGPT Images chat can reliably execute one explicit image task when all project orchestration and historical context are removed from the generator conversation.

experiment_relation.only_question: Can the native renderer execute the requested subject/aspect/reference binding in a stateless fresh chat?

image_task: Create exactly one photo-only 3:4 portrait image of a real working rice granary in early morning. The scene must visibly contain pale rice grains, woven bamboo baskets, linen sacks, aged wooden grain bins, and a modest sorting/preparation table. Use believable documentary photography, cool-neutral morning daylight, realistic wood/cloth/rice materials, and one natural quiet low-detail area that could later hold typography. Do not include any people as the main subject, beauty/wellness products, bottles, cosmetics, supplements, laptops, home-office lifestyle scenes, tea ware, mountains/forest scenery, wok/fire, logos, labels, calligraphy, readable text, advertising copy, detached graphic panels, or invented brands. Use the attached R1C image only for overall visual family feeling and relational balance; do not copy its subject, brand, text, motifs, or layout.
pass_conditions: rice, baskets, linen sacks, aged wooden grain bins and sorting/preparation surface are visibly present
no readable/generated advertising text or invented brand
raw PNG archived to Drive with matching SHA
